verdict.rationale: Qdrant's docs show a per-collection distance metric set in vectors_config (Distance.DOT), and the GitHub README describes an API to store and search vectors. A community user reports the core search is fast and accurate. The evidence never names the approximate (ANN/HNSW) index or lists the full set of supported metrics, so coverage is partial. missing for 10: explicit documentation of approximate nearest-neighbor indexing (e.g., HNSW and its tuning), an enumerated list of supported distance metrics beyond Dot, and independent hands-on corroboration of ANN recall/latency.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run approximate nearest-neighbor similarity search over embeddings with configurable distance metrics

citations.quote: It provides a production-ready service with a convenient API to store, search, and manage points—vectors with an additional payload.
It's fast, good accuracy, easy to use.
